Recyclable.description: Materials that can be reprocessed into new products such as paper, plastic bottles, glass, and metals.
disposal_instructions: Rinse and dry the container to remove food/beverage residue.
Separate caps, lids, and labels if required by local recycling rules.
Flatten cardboard boxes and crush plastic bottles to save space.
Place into the dedicated Blue Recycling Bin.
avoid: Do not include soiled paper, food-contaminated boxes (e.g. greasy pizza boxes), or broken glass.

Organic.description: Biodegradable matter such as food scraps, garden waste, fruit peels, and coffee grounds.
disposal_instructions: Collect in a breathable or compostable bag.
Keep free from plastic stickers, twist ties, or synthetic wrappers.
Deposit in a compost bin or Green Organics Bin for municipal composting.
avoid: Do not mix with plastic wrappers, treated wood, or meat waste if prohibited by home composting.

E-waste.description: Discarded electronic devices, circuit boards, cables, chargers, appliances, and accessories.
disposal_instructions: Wipe personal data off devices before recycling.
Take to a designated E-Waste Drop-off facility or tech retailer recycling kiosk.
Never dispose in standard household trash bins.
avoid: Do not throw in household garbage or incinerators.

Hazardous.description: Toxic, flammable, corrosive, or reactive materials that pose environmental and safety risks.
disposal_instructions: Store upright in a sealed, leak-proof container.
Tape battery terminals with electrical tape to prevent short circuits.
Drop off at a certified Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) collection point.
Handle with care using protective gloves.
avoid: Never pour down drains, flush down toilets, or place in standard trash bins.

General Waste.description: Non-recyclable, non-hazardous, and non-compostable everyday refuse.
disposal_instructions: Bag securely to prevent litter and odor.
Dispose in the standard Black/Grey General Trash Bin.
Aim to minimize consumption of non-recyclable single-use items.
avoid: Do not place hazardous waste, electronics, or clean recyclables here.
